newsitem.title: USA: Ultradata Systems says orders soar in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Ultradata Systems says orders soar in Q4.

text.p: Ultradata Systems Inc said Monday its order backlog for the end of 1996 was $6.8 million, compared to $75,000 one year ago, thanks primarily to two major custom orders in the fourth quarter.
The company said the two orders were worth $3.5 million and $3 million.

"We're shifting our sales and marketing approach," said Michael Woerther, Ultradata's controller. "We used to sell our products through catalogs, but we're finding there are niche markets out there that want custom versions of products."
Ultradata makes handheld electronic information devices. Its shares were trading unchanged Monday at 7-5/8.
